reviews.title: Close AS3 Areas 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 AMF3, RegExp, Stage, Mouse, Bitmap, Text and NetStream gaps
reviews.summary: Adds AMF3 Vector, Dictionary, and IExternalizable codecs, PCRE RegExp named groups/conditionals/inline flags, Stage quality/wmodeGPU/colorCorrection/mouseLock, areInaccessibleObjectsUnderPoint, MouseCursorData PNG cursors, BitmapData JPEG-XR encode and lock/unlock, Font.hasGlyphs, TextRenderer/CSMSettings, and NetStream progressive bytesLoaded and play aggregation.

entries.note: Decodes AMF0 and AMF3 graphs including Vector.<int|uint|Number|*|Object> and typed Vectors (preserving fixed and object references), Dictionary (weakKeys and object/primitive keys), and IExternalizable.readExternal via registerClassAlias.

Encodes AMF0 and AMF3 graphs including Vector.<int|uint|Number|*|Object> and typed Vectors, Dictionary (weakKeys and object/primitive keys), and IExternalizable.writeExternal across ByteArray and SharedObject .sol persistence.

Supports g/i/m/s/x flags, PCRE named groups (?P<name>...) and (?<name>...), named backreferences and $<name> replacements, inline (?imsx-imsx) modifiers, (?#...) comments, conditionals (?(1)a|b)/(?(name)a|b)/(?(?=...)a|b), and \a/\e/\A/\Z/\z/\x{...} escapes.
RegExp(re) returns the same RegExp instance when no flags are supplied, whereas new RegExp(re, flags) clones or overrides flags with lastIndex reset to 0 and PCRE-compatible pattern translation.
Validates StageQuality constants, updates Canvas 2D imageSmoothingEnabled/imageSmoothingQuality and CSS imageRendering on Stage redraws, and rejects invalid values with ArgumentError.
Read-only Boolean reflecting active GPU/WebGL wmode acceleration (false on 2D Canvas/DOM, true when wmode is 'gpu' or gpu_web_gl compositing is active).
Validates ColorCorrection.DEFAULT/ON/OFF, updates DOM/CSS color-interpolation and stage color-correction attributes, triggers Stage redraws, and throws ArgumentError on invalid strings.

Reports ColorCorrectionSupport based on host Canvas 2D colorSpace and CSS color-gamut media queries ('defaultOn' on color-managed sRGB/Display-P3 surfaces, 'unsupported' when unconfigured in headless VMs).

Enforces fullscreen-only IllegalOperationError contract, requests and exits browser Pointer Lock on the Stage surface, syncs with pointerlockchange, and delivers relative movementX/movementY MouseEvent deltas.
Returns true when cross-sandbox display leaves without Security.allowDomain permission intersect the stage point (and filters them from getObjectsUnderPoint), returning false once access is granted.
Reports true when attached to an interactive DOM/Canvas cursor surface capable of rendering custom PNG MouseCursorData cursors and false on headless surfaces.
Validates MouseCursorData frames and encodes RGBA BitmapData frames into RFC-2083 PNG data-URI CSS cursors with hotSpot coordinates and frameRate-driven multi-frame cursor animation.
Removes registered custom cursor definitions, stops active cursor frame timers, and resets the active cursor to MouseCursor.AUTO when unregistered.
Final cursor descriptor class holding Vector.<BitmapData> frames, Point hotSpot, and Number frameRate for Mouse.registerCursor.
Constructs a MouseCursorData instance initialized with data = null, hotSpot = (0, 0), and frameRate = 0.
Reads and validates Vector.<BitmapData> cursor frames for custom native cursor encoding.
Reads and validates nonnegative finite cursor animation frame rate in frames per second.
Reads and clones the cursor registration Point hotSpot applied to CSS url(...) x y cursor coordinates.
Encodes bounded sub-rectangles into ByteArray using PNGEncoderOptions, JPEGEncoderOptions, or JPEGXREncoderOptions (ITU-T T.832 .jxr container honoring quantization, colorSpace, and trimFlexBits).
Supports nested lock reference counting that freezes cached display uploads and defers display invalidations while direct pixel mutations proceed on the BitmapData.
Balances nested lock() calls, coalesces optional Rectangle changeRect regions, updates partial or full display pixels, and triggers a single display invalidation flush when the outer lock releases.
Options class configuring ITU-T T.832 JPEG-XR quantization, chroma subsampling colorSpace, and flex-bits trimming for BitmapData.encode.
Constructs JPEGXREncoderOptions with defaults quantization = 20, colorSpace = BitmapEncodingColorSpace.COLORSPACE_AUTO, and trimFlexBits = 0.
Selects BitmapEncodingColorSpace ('auto', '4:4:4', '4:2:2', '4:2:0') for JPEG-XR chroma subsampling and validates on BitmapData.encode.
Controls JPEG-XR lossy quantization step size (0 for lossless YCoCg-R encoding, higher values increasing compression).
Controls JPEG-XR high-frequency flexbits trimming (0..15) during frequency-band serialization.
Constant enumeration class defining chroma subsampling modes for JPEGXREncoderOptions.
Constant '4:2:0' selecting 2x2 chroma subsampling in BitmapData.encode with JPEGXREncoderOptions.
Constant '4:2:2' selecting 2x1 horizontal chroma subsampling in BitmapData.encode with JPEGXREncoderOptions.
Constant '4:4:4' selecting full-resolution chroma channels in BitmapData.encode with JPEGXREncoderOptions.
Constant 'auto' selecting automatic chroma format in BitmapData.encode with JPEGXREncoderOptions.
Checks exact SFNT cmap Format 4/12 and TTC glyph coverage for embedded fonts, and verifies installed face availability plus Canvas .notdef tofu glyph raster comparison for device fonts.
Dispatches non-bubbling Event('textInteractionModeChange') when user touch-selection, Alt-pointer, or context-menu interaction switches TextField.textInteractionMode between 'normal' and 'selection'.
Continuous Stroke Modulation table entry class consumed by TextRenderer.setAdvancedAntiAliasingTable.
Constructs CSMSettings(fontSize, insideCutoff, outsideCutoff) with validated numeric fields.
Reads and writes the target pixel fontSize key for CSM cutoff interpolation.
Reads and writes the CSM insideCutoff threshold modulating stroke weight on advanced-antialiased text.
Reads and writes the CSM outsideCutoff threshold modulating edge contrast and sharpness on advanced-antialiased text.
Enumeration class supplying subpixel display mode constants for TextRenderer.displayMode.
Constant 'crt' enabling phosphor-bloom CRT antialiasing in TextRenderer.
Constant 'default' selecting standard grayscale antialiasing in TextRenderer.
Constant 'lcd' enabling RGB subpixel antialiasing passes in TextRenderer.
Static advanced-antialiasing controller driving CSM stroke/contrast interpolation, subpixel display modes, and antialiasing quality levels across Canvas text rendering.
Reads and sets TextDisplayMode ('default', 'lcd', 'crt'), throwing ArgumentError on invalid strings and updating Canvas text subpixel/CRT rendering.
Reads and sets static antialiasing quality level clamped to 0..64 (default 4), controlling stroke smoothing intensity.
Registers CSMSettings arrays per fontName, FontStyle, and TextColorType ('dark'/'light') and interpolates cutoffs by font size and luminance during AntiAliasType.ADVANCED rendering.

Supports local/HTTP(S) media (with negative start playing from 0 and RTMP URLs reporting StreamNotFound), HLS/DASH live streams (duration = Infinity), start/len clipping, single-frame len = 0, play(false), play(null) data generation, and reset modes 0/1/2/3 with playlist status-message aggregation.

Reports exact embedded/appendBytes counts and real observed HTTP progressive transfer bytes from streaming Fetch chunks, 206 Range probes, and PerformanceResourceTiming (falling back to buffered estimation only on opaque cross-origin media).
